recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a targeted active-source correction that reconciles FHIR-34033 with later applied data-exchange decisions without adding a new invariant or changing examples outside the evidence-supported scope.
issue_request: FHIR-34033 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification CQI change request for R5 MeasureReport.evaluatedResource. It asked to avoid wording that implied evaluatedResource should contain every resource considered during evaluation, and the final resolution clarified bounded evaluatedResource use, R5 supplemental-data separation, and a subject-list example.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by f19cf89c19ca2169c4df72ed0e24161259840ba0, which changed the evaluatedResource definition to individual-only wording and added a subject-list MeasureReport example. That application addressed the original concern but became too narrow after later data-exchange decisions.
additional_context: MeasureReport is active in source/fhir.ini. Later applied CQI work, including FHIR-51066, FHIR-50487, and FHIR-39174, makes data-exchange MeasureReports a current build use case for evaluatedResource. Current collect-data/submit-data operation sources and examples use MeasureReport.type=data-exchange with evaluatedResource references to data-of-interest.
reconciliation: Edited source/measurereport/structuredefinition-MeasureReport.xml to update the evaluatedResource short text, definition, comment, and committee note. The new wording preserves FHIR-34033's bounded-data intent while allowing the later data-exchange use and keeping subject-list/summary reports on their population and subject reporting elements.
source_changes: source/measurereport/structuredefinition-MeasureReport.xml: revised MeasureReport.evaluatedResource committee note, short, definition, and comment to describe individual and data-exchange report scopes.
